facts.en: Completed a visual merchandising certificate at Fictional Dapple College in 2018.
facts.zh: 2018 年在虚构斑影学院完成视觉陈列证书课程。

facts.en: Paid shop display assistant at Fictional Plumwindow Retail from 2019-03 to 2022-12.
facts.zh: 2019-03 至 2022-12 在虚构梅窗零售公司任有薪门店陈列助理。

facts.en: Prepared product labels and maintained a display-prop lending list in that role.
facts.zh: 在该岗位准备产品标签，并维护陈列道具借用清单。

facts.en: Paid sample-room assistant at Fictional Cottonkite Textiles from 2023-02 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-02 至 2026-08 在虚构棉鸢纺织公司任有薪样品室助理。

facts.en: Labeled fabric swatches with supplier codes, received dates and the client’s requested reference.
facts.zh: 为布样标注供应商代码、收件日期及客户要求的参考编号。

facts.en: Tracked swatch loans and requested returns before scheduled design reviews.
facts.zh: 跟踪布样借用，并在预定设计审核前请求归还。

facts.en: Compared swatches with an approved reference under the sample-room lightbox and referred visible differences to a technologist.
facts.zh: 在样品室灯箱下将布样与获批参考样比较，并将可见差异转交技术员。

facts.en: A textile technologist made colour-approval decisions and signed test reports.
facts.zh: 纺织技术员作出色彩批准决定，并签署测试报告。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet lookups, label templates and barcode scanning for sample locations.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格查找、标签模板及条码扫描定位样品。

facts.en: Reindexed 120 archived swatch envelopes with a colleague during 2025-06.
facts.zh: 2025-06 与一名同事共同重新索引 120 个归档布样信封。

facts.en: Personally checked supplier-code fields for 65 envelopes; the colleague checked the remaining 55.
facts.zh: 个人核对 65 个信封的供应商代码字段；同事核对其余 55 个。

facts.en: The team found 11 envelopes with outdated location labels across the 120-envelope set.
facts.zh: 团队在这组 120 个信封中发现 11 个位置标签过时的信封。

facts.en: The project log does not attribute those 11 findings to either person individually.
facts.zh: 项目日志未将这 11 项发现分别归属于任何一人。

facts.en: Packed approved samples for dispatch and retained courier-reference records.
facts.zh: 将获批样品打包发运，并保留快递编号记录。

facts.en: Completed a 2023 internal lightbox orientation; no professional colour-grading qualification was issued.
facts.zh: 2023 年完成内部灯箱使用入门培训；未颁发专业色彩评级资格。

facts.en: Made a personal patchwork pattern book in 2024 using leftover household fabric.
facts.zh: 2024 年使用家中剩余布料制作个人拼布图案册。

facts.en: That personal book was not a commercial textile collection and contained no performance-test results.
facts.zh: 该个人图案册不是商业纺织系列，且不含性能测试结果。

facts.en: Volunteered to label costumes for Fictional Fernlight Amateur Theatre during 2021-09.
facts.zh: 2021-09 志愿为虚构蕨光业余剧团的服装贴标签。

facts.en: Enjoys sketching repeating geometric patterns.
facts.zh: 爱好绘制重复几何图案。

facts.en: No production-lot release responsibility or independently signed textile test is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录生产批次放行职责或独立签署纺织测试报告的经历。
